name: Default
shortDescription: Lightweight DNS proxy and ad blocker with deny and allow lists, caching and a REST API, answering DNS-over-HTTPS queries on the app domain.

alerts.message: Plain DNS on port 53 is not published. Point clients at https://<your domain>/dns-query as their DNS-over-HTTPS resolver.
Blocky has no login. Anyone who reaches the domain can use it as a DoH resolver and call the REST API under /api, which can disable blocking, flush the cache and refresh the lists.
